result.title: VisualTalk-Bench: Evaluating Question-Driven Avatar-Led Video Explanations
result.summary: Advances in video generation and avatar synthesis enable new ways to answer user questions through visual explanations. This task requires a system to formulate a correct answer, translate relevant information into visual material, and deliver the explanation through an avatar's speech and actions. Existing benchmarks rarely assess whether avatars point to the visual content being discussed. We introduce VisualTalk-Bench for question-driven avatar-led video explanations in finance and Chinese and English education. It includes 800 curated reference videos and 100 independent evaluation requests, assessing Content Factuality, Speech-Visual Consistency, Visual Quality, Motion Smoothness, and Avatar-Content Pointing. Yet end-to-end video generators often struggle to align gestures with specific visual targets. To explore this challenge, we develop Avatar-O Agent, a modular reference implementation with explicit interaction planning. Experiments across six agents show that factual precision and visual quality do not guarantee accurate pointing. A 26-participant study comparing four agents finds that Avatar-O Agent receives the highest average ratings for visual guidance, perceived pointing accuracy, and explanation effectiveness. We will release the data and code.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VisualTalk-Bench，用 800 条参考视频与 100 条评测请求，评估金融与中英文教育场景中由 avatar 主导、问题驱动的视频解释，并给出含显式交互规划的 Avatar-O Agent 参考实现。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于 avatar 视频生成与多维度人工/指标评测，关注语音-画面一致与手势指向，但未涉及模型内部推理状态、视觉证据筛选或 latent 表示的生成与使用，与 LVR 主线缺少可迁移的具体线索。
